overview_description.description: Presto overlays next-gen digital solutions onto the physical world. Presto’s enterprise-grade voice, vision, and touch technologies help hospitality businesses thrive while delighting guests. With over 250,000 systems shipped, Presto is one of the largest labor automation technology providers in the industry. Founded at M.I.T. in 2008, Presto is headquartered in Silicon Valley, Calif. with customers including many of the top 20 restaurant chains in the U.S.

about_short_description.short_description: Presto is a software company that provides AI and automation solutions to the restaurant industry.

product.name: Presto Voice™
product.description: An AI-powered drive-thru ordering assistant that automates order taking, recommends add-ons, improves order accuracy, and integrates with restaurant POS and headset systems.

product.name: Presto Phone Ordering
product.description: A voice AI phone-ordering solution for quick-service restaurants that automates inbound order interactions and extends Presto’s restaurant voice automation capabilities.

product.name: Menu Unification
product.description: A menu management product intended to standardize restaurant menu data for more consistent and scalable deployment of drive-thru voice AI across locations.

product.name: Presto IQ
product.description: An AI-focused restaurant technology offering associated with voice and large-language-model systems for enterprise quick-service restaurant operations.

identifier.value: Voice AI Integration and Deployment Services

product.name: Voice AI Integration and Deployment Services
product.description: Implementation services that connect Presto’s voice automation with restaurant POS and headset systems and support installation across restaurant locations.

product.name: Presto Contactless Dining Kit
product.description: A QR-code-based restaurant ordering solution that lets guests view menus, place orders, join waitlists, and pay using their mobile devices.
